newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SHOW JUMPING-WORLD CUP SPONSOR VOLVO PULLS OUT.
newsitem.headline: SHOW JUMPING-WORLD CUP SPONSOR VOLVO PULLS OUT.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Monday it would stop sponsoring the show jumping and dressage world cups at the end of next season.
"The dressage finals in Gothenburg on April 2-5 1998 and the show jumping finals in Helsinki 16-19 April 1998 will be the end of Volvo's focus on equestrian sports," the company said in a statement.
Volvo has been the main sponsor for the show jumping World Cup since 1978 and the dressage World Cup since 1990.

"It is natural that a close-to 20-year-old project should be considered carefully ahead of a possible renewal and in this case, after consulting our marketing companies and importers around the world, we found we should not use the option to extend the contract," a company spokesman said.
